text_block_list.text:
—The new year has begun.
Starting this year, Narita Brian takes on
the challenge of the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: What is it?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is there no kotatsu?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...If we're watching New Year's TV,
that's an absolute must. Along with mandarin oranges.
choice_data_list: Is it really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I need it, no matter what.
I set up a kotatsu and brought some mikan to the room, just as Narita Brian had asked.

...The person in question is currently slipping their legs under the kotatsu,
thoroughly basking in its warmth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Turn on the TV too.
It's about to start."

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!
Here is the first edition of 'Our Race Bulletin' for the new year!

text_block_list.name: Show Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Various Umamusume made their mark last year, didn't they?
Starting from the spring, there was Rice Shower's run
that halted Mejiro McQueen's consecutive victories!

text_block_list.name: Show Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The battle between the three of them over the
Classic Triple Crown was truly heated as well!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: Yes. Yes! Even among them, the one who truly became the face of last year was—

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's Biwa Hayahide-san, who was also chosen as this year's Horse Girl of the Year!!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It's the real deal~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide-san, Narita Brian-san, who is debuting this year, is your younger sister, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My sister is an exceptionally strong Umamusume.
Thanks to her, it has been a truly invigorating year for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On the Classic Triple Crown path, I was only able to win the Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe she has what it takes
to become a Triple Crown Umamusume."
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: (So Brian's a Triple Crown Uma Musume...)
(Brian as a Triple Crown Uma Musume...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We're out of mandarins.
I'll go get some.

choice_data_list: (There's... no tension at all!)

text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I heard. Sounds like you're going for the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And what if I say yes?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading for the Tiara route.
The Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...When I watched your Asahi Hai FS,
that's when I finally realized.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That honestly, even if I challenged you as I am right now, winning would be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's why it'll be one year from now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna spend a whole year polishing myself up!
I'll claim the honors of the Triple Tiara and get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So at the end of the year, at the Arima Kinen!
Don't you dare run away—face me one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown you're aiming for, versus
the Triple Tiara that I'm going to take.
I'll show you which one shines brighter!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's all I wanted to say.
See ya, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wait, Ama-san.
(Whoosh...... smack!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is this?
......A mandarin orange?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A parting gift. Take it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the match.
I'm looking forward to the race.
Mandarins are packed with nutrients, after all.
Mandarins are packed with nutrients, you know.
Did you just give aid to the enemy?
Did you just help the enemy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the match.
I'm looking forward to the race.
Mandarins are packed with nutrients, after all.
Mandarins are packed with nutrients, you know.
Did you just give aid to the enemy?
Did you just help the enemy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Looking at those eyes,
it seems she intends to build up considerable strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I shall look forward to the day
we face each other in the real event.
choice_data_list: Shall we get to training over here too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if we don't put the kotatsu away just yet?
We decided to keep the kotatsu out over the New Year's holidays as a reward after training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "That is correct. If you intend to compete, you must nourish yourself properly."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We are... racers, after all.
choice_data_list: That's a great attitude.
That's a great attitude.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm merely quoting Sis.
Those aren't my words."

Narita Brian eagerly climbed into the kotatsu
and began eating mikan oranges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh. Something of this caliber won't even scratch my armor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I were to race against Ama-san
after she's won the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What kind of strategy do you plan on formulating?
What kind of training will you assign to me?

And so, with Narita Brian entering battle mode,
we spent the very start of the New Year discussing race strategy.
